relationships.subject: GPR177
relationships.evidence_quote: GPR177 mediated the secretion of WNT5a from A-fiber DRG neurons into cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), which was necessary for the maintenance of DNP

relationships.subject: WNT5a
relationships.evidence_quote: Extracellular perfusion of WNT5a induced rapid currents in both TRPV1-expressing heterologous cells and nociceptive DRG neurons.

relationships.subject: GPR177
relationships.evidence_quote: GPR177 is mainly expressed in large-diameter A-fiber dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons and required for the development of DNP in mice

key_findings: GPR177 in A-fiber DRG neurons drives diabetic neuropathic pain via secretion of WNT5a, which acts as an endogenous TRPV1 agonist.
A peptide disrupting the WNT5a/TRPV1 interaction suppressed DNP symptoms in rodents.
